preamble: The shift from a nasal [n] to a lateral [l] is a form of denasalization or lateralization. This is frequently observed in East Asian languages.

examples.note: Southern Min nasal initials become voiced stops or flaps; Jieyang keeps nam2 (Proto-Min article, sample table).
